label: Matt 22:1
text: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

label: Matt 22:2
text: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a marriage feast for his son,

label: Matt 22:3
text: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the marriage feast, but they would not come.

label: Matt 22:4
text: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the marriage feast!”’

label: Matt 22:5
text: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise,

label: Matt 22:6
text: and the rest grabbed his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.

label: Matt 22:7
text: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

label: Matt 22:8
text: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

label: Matt 22:9
text: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the marriage feast.’

label: Matt 22:10
text: Those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

variants.reading: γαμος ('wedding') — the WEB reading 'The wedding was filled with guests'
variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia 'Textual variants in the Gospel of Matthew' lists γαμος (wedding) for B(1), D, W, Θ, 33, 085, 0161, f1, f13 and the majority/Byzantine text - the reading the WEB prints.
The fetched Wikipedia 'Textual variants in the Gospel of Matthew' lists νυμφων (bride) for א (Sinaiticus), B* (the original hand of Vaticanus), L, 0138, 892 and 1010.

label: Matt 22:11
text: But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

label: Matt 22:12
text: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

label: Matt 22:13
text: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

label: Matt 22:14
text: For many are called, but few chosen.”

label: Matt 22:15
text: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

label: Matt 22:16
text: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach, for you aren’t partial to anyone.

label: Matt 22:17
text: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

label: Matt 22:18
text:
But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said,
“Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

label: Matt 22:19
text:
Show me the tax money.”
They brought to him a denarius.

label: Matt 22:20
text:
He asked them,
“Whose is this image and inscription?”

label: Matt 22:21
text:
They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
Then he said to them,
“Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

label: Matt 22:22
text: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.

label: Matt 22:23
text: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

label: Matt 22:24
text: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.’

label: Matt 22:25
text: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

label: Matt 22:26
text: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

label: Matt 22:27
text: After them all, the woman died.

label: Matt 22:28
text: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

label: Matt 22:29
text:
But Jesus answered them,
“You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

label: Matt 22:30
text: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

variants.reading: γαμιζονται ('are married') instead of εκγαμιζονται ('are given in marriage')
variants.note: The fetched Wikipedia 'Textual variants in the Gospel of Matthew' lists γαμιζονται for א (Sinaiticus), B (Vaticanus), D, f1, 892, 1010 and 1424, against εκγαμιζονται in L, 0138, 0161, 0197 and the Byzantine text, which the WEB prints ('nor are given in marriage').

label: Matt 22:31
text: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

label: Matt 22:32
text:
‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?’
God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

label: Matt 22:33
text: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

label: Matt 22:34
text: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

label: Matt 22:35
text: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

label: Matt 22:36
text: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

label: Matt 22:37
text:
Jesus said to him,
“‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

label: Matt 22:38
text: This is the first and great commandment.

label: Matt 22:39
text: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

label: Matt 22:40
text: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

label: Matt 22:41
text: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

label: Matt 22:42
text:
saying,
“What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?”

They said to him, “Of David.”

label: Matt 22:43
text:
He said to them,
“How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

label: Matt 22:44
text:
‘The Lord said to my Lord,
sit on my right hand,
until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet?’

label: Matt 22:45
text: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

label: Matt 22:46
text: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

label: The king's marriage feast and its invited guests
statement: A king made a marriage feast for his son and sent out his servants to call those who were invited.

label: The king's armies burned their city
statement: In the parable, the king sent his armies, destroyed the murderers and burned their city.

label: The wedding garment required of the guest
statement: A guest at the marriage feast without wedding clothing was challenged, bound and cast out.

label: The Pharisees and the Herodians together
statement: The Pharisees sent their disciples, along with the Herodians, to entrap Jesus in his talk.

label: The tribute question
statement: Whether it was lawful to pay taxes to Caesar was a live question in Judea.

label: The denarius brought to Jesus
statement: They brought Jesus a denarius when he asked to see the tax money.

label: Caesar's image and inscription on the coin
statement: The coin bore Caesar's image and inscription, and Jesus said to give to Caesar the things that are Caesar's.

label: The Sadducees deny the resurrection
statement: The Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to Jesus with a question.

label: Levirate marriage
statement: Moses commanded that if a man dies having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.

label: Exodus 3:6 quoted
statement: Jesus quoted 'I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob' (Exodus 3:6) about the resurrection of the dead.

label: The Shema's love command as the greatest commandment
statement: The first and great commandment is 'You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind' (Deut 6:5).

label: The Christ as the son of David
statement: The Christ was expected to be the son of David.

label: Psalm 110:1 quoted
statement: Jesus quoted Psalm 110:1, 'The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.'
